description: Stable, owner-scoped trade ledger for reconciliation and exports. Follow next_cursor until null. Rows label live and live-mock activity explicitly and disclose missing historical fee or PnL fields. Simulation rows are included and labelled mode paper (never money activity); pass include_simulation:false for live activity only. This is not a tax statement and never moves money.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous page.

include_simulation.description: Include simulation rows (labelled mode paper). Default true.

limit.description: Maximum trade rows in this page. Defaults to 100.

name: get_account_statement
